name: Descentarium
detailed_description:
Play as Kero, a determined frog trapped in a strange, enclosed world with no clear way out. This 2D roguelike platformer takes you deep into dark, shifting caves filled with hidden dangers, valuable resources, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Dig, explore, and adapt to the ever-changing underground as you search for an escape. But the deeper you go, the more questions arise-where exactly are you, and who put you here?

Every run brings new discoveries. Will you leap your way to freedom, or remain lost in the depths forever?

Key Features:

Procedurally Generated Caves - Explore ever-changing underground environments that combine hand-crafted rooms with procedural layouts, ensuring no two runs are the same.

Dynamic Systems - The world responds to your actions in unexpected ways, encouraging experimentation and creative problem-solving.

Terrain-Based Gameplay - Dig through and manipulate the environment to uncover secrets, create new paths, or escape danger.

Fluid & Light Simulation - Navigate caves shaped by flowing liquids and dynamic lighting that both challenge and guide your descent.

Risk vs. Reward Exploration - Decide how deep to push your run, the further you go, the greater the rewards-and the higher the stakes.
